bounded_objective: Determine whether the source-influence coefficient 8 ln(2), forced by the point-defect associator family, is sufficient on a strictly broader correlated all-parameter class and under actual changing hierarchy weights.
prior_status: Overlap plus the selector alpha-log envelope was refuted as an associator payment; source influence had the correct scale on one point-defect family but no positive sufficiency theorem covered correlated defects.
mathematical_delta: For every affine-coset flip of a character, the signed associator is zero in the varying-character regime, nonpositive on the positive level, and at most 8 ln(2) I(b) on the negative level. The constant is sharp. The exact nonreuse derivative ledger sums the theorem through adaptive hierarchies without depth or activation loss.

case_extension.starting_class: One negative-level point defect with asymptotic source ratio 8 ln(2).
case_extension.new_class: All affine-coset flips of arbitrary nonconstant characters, including correlated affine constraints and adaptive nonreusing hierarchies whose local sources are restrictions of one physical source.
case_extension.quantifiers: Every ambient dimension, every affine coset of codimension k>=1, every nonconstant character, every allowed hierarchy depth and actual reach-weight profile.
case_extension.previous_bound: Necessary coefficient >=8 ln(2) from one family; sufficiency unknown.
case_extension.new_bound: sum_v w_v Omega_v <=8 ln(2) I(b), with equality constant asymptotically sharp.
case_extension.parameter_dependence: No dependence on dimension, codimension, active support size, depth, address count, overlap, or activation weights.

acceptance_evidence: AFFINE_DEFECT_RESERVE.tex: all-dimension exact proof, hierarchy corollary, and sharpness
check_affine_defect.py/check_affine_defect.out: exact Walsh reconstruction of all 4998 affine-coset/character instances through n=4 and the B01 control
remaining_obstacle: Arbitrary branch-difference sources need not have flat translated Fourier support. No single-use terminal reserve yet controls mixtures of affine cosets or general coherent source spectra across multiple ancestors.
next_action: Prove or falsify a two-coset extension: decompose b into two signed affine-coset pieces with overlapping translated spectra, retain their signed cross term, and charge only one nonflat terminal reserve in addition to 8 ln(2) I(b).

validation.arithmetic: Exact Fraction Walsh transforms and influence; floating natural-log entropy only for finite reconstruction, with analytic exact formulas proving the theorem.
validation.scope: All affine cosets and nonconstant characters through n=4, 4998 total instances; explicit B01/A003 two-defect control.
